Chapter 1032: 2: Ten Thousand Laws And Paths (Requesting Monthly Tickets)

Chapter 1032: Chapter 2: Ten Thousand Laws and Paths (Requesting Monthly Tickets)

Deep within the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming.

“Who is spying on me?”

Ancient Ming Venerable opened his eyes, his expression flickering with astonishment.

“It must be some passing Venerable.”

Ancient Ming Venerable immediately sensed the prying gaze retreating swiftly, and speculated inwardly.

To be able to see through the layers of formations within the Chaos Continent and locate the place where he was in closed-door training.

The opponent’s mastery of space-time must at least be at the Eighth Realm.

“Just arrived in this void and perhaps piqued the curiosity of nearby Venerables who came to investigate?”

Ancient Ming Venerable speculated inwardly.

The comprehension of the Eighth Realm of Space-Time already belongs to the domain of seasoned Chaos Venerables.

Ordinary newly-advanced Chaos Venerables still remain at the peak of the Seventh Realm in space-time mastery.

…

‘Fragment World’ of Star Tear.

Lin Yuan was using the insights of the Eighth Realm of Space-Time, constantly observing the space-time around him.

“Whether it is the distance traveled through the void or the mastery of space-time, both have improved significantly.”

Lin Yuan marveled inwardly, with the primary takeaway being that, in the future, when facing enemies at the Venerable level, he would no longer be suppressed in the Space-Time Domain.

Mastery in the realm of space-time was akin to having the initiative—offense or retreat could be controlled.

“I wonder what the Ninth Realm of Space-Time would be like.”

Lin Yuan wondered silently.

The Eighth Realm of Space-Time is a level only accessible to Chaos Venerables, while the Ninth Realm belongs to the domain of Chaos Great Saints or even peerless Great Saints.

As a peerless Great Saint, Xuanhuang has the power to open thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Xuanhuang Secret Realms scattered across different universes, primarily relying on the peak comprehension of the Ninth Realm of Space-Time.

…

“This session of closed-door training can be considered finished.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts. Despite reaching the Eighth Realm in space-time mastery, he felt no trace of arrogance. The insight of the Eighth Realm only allowed him to face Chaos Venerables with ease.

But what if it was a Chaos Great Saint?

Lin Yuan still vividly remembered the obliteration of his home universe in the aftermath of the battle between the Shadow Demon Great Saint and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

From beginning to end, he hadn’t even seen traces of the two Great Saints themselves; the residual power fluctuations from their clash alone sufficed to erase everything, instilling in Lin Yuan a deep sense of helplessness.

“With my current foundation, if I were to ascend into the Master Realm, even if I still wouldn’t be able to rival a Great Saint, I would at least have some degree of self-preservation, wouldn’t I? No longer an ant that could be casually crushed by a Great Saint?”

Lin Yuan speculated inwardly.

The leap from the Path Splitting Realm to the Master Realm is a major cross-tier progression within the twelve layers of cultivation, marking a qualitative transformation in combat power.

For Lin Yuan, the same principle applies. At that point, the ‘Infinite Void’ and other subsequent realms could continue to be cultivated.

“The Master Realm… It’s close.”

Lin Yuan felt the distance between his physical body and soul nearing their peak, silently pondering to himself.

…

“This session of closed-door training, achieving the insight of the Eighth Realm of Space-Time, can be considered an unexpected fortune.”

Lin Yuan’s mind surfaced with the many Martial Tao sub-paths he had just opened and perfected, “Seventy-three Martial Tao sub-paths in total; theoretically, these seventy-three sub-paths can each lead to the twelfth layer.”

Lin Yuan felt quite pleased inwardly.

The more Martial Tao sub-paths, the wider the scope of the Martial Tao itself. If it weren’t for the vastness, how could so many paths be established?

The muddy small paths, no matter how they are extended, could never become a grand avenue leading to transcendence.

“Those people from Xuanyuan’s side asked me to buy some twelfth-layer evolution paths… Why would I need to buy them? Aren’t they already readily available?”

Lin Yuan’s face showed a faint smile; seventy-three Martial Tao sub-paths leading directly to the twelfth layer were more than sufficient for human civilization to use for countless years to come.

“Actually, if I continued the closed-door training, I could further perfect and forge more Martial Tao sub-paths. But there’s no need to do so.”

Lin Yuan thought inwardly.

The core of Martial Tao’s evolution lies in the fundamental avenue. Once the pathway of many sub-paths is opened, various sub-paths will continuously emerge.

Lin Yuan merely needed to guide them along the way.

…

“Hm?”

“Wanqu Master is looking for me?”

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted slightly, immediately dividing off an incarnation to leave the ‘Fragment World’ of Star Tear and head toward the Chaos Continent of Ancient Ming.

In Mingchuan City, within a pavilion, Lin Yuan and Wanqu Master sat facing each other.

“Galaxy Brother, I did not fail you.”

Wanqu Master smiled and said while looking at Lin Yuan.

Since Ancient Ming Venerable personally issued the order last time to nearly give away the ‘Fragment World’ of Star Tear to Lin Yuan…

Wanqu Master realized that Lin Yuan’s origins might be deeply terrifying.

Later on, Wanqu Master sought an audience with Ancient Ming Venerable, intending to probe into Lin Yuan’s background. In the end, Ancient Ming Venerable only left him with one warning.

“If you offend Galaxy, the entire Chaos Continent will be annihilated.”

Wanqu Master still remembered clearly the expression Ancient Ming Venerable had when he made that statement, filled with boundless dread and fear.

It was precisely because of this that Wanqu Master had been fulfilling all of Lin Yuan’s requests during this time.

“Hahaha, many thanks.” Lin Yuan said cheerfully.

Not long ago, he had requested Wanqu Master…

To help sell eighteen Master Realm-level extraordinary trees obtained from ‘Cang Weiyang’ senior, hoping to exchange them for specific cultivation resources or Chaos Stones.

These eighteen extraordinary trees bore Spirit Fruits periodically and were tantamount to money trees for a force, with the potential for continued inheritance.

But for Lin Yuan, they were somewhat redundant.

The fruiting cycle of the eighteen extraordinary trees started at a minimum of one million years, and within that time frame… Considering Lin Yuan’s rate of growth, by the next million years, he might very well have already ascended to the Chaos Realm.

From the perspective of a Chaos Venerable, the eighteen extraordinary trees were insignificant, let alone the Spirit Fruits they bore.

These eighteen extraordinary trees weren’t the World Tree nurtured by Lin Yuan’s inner universe, which has the effect of stabilizing his inner cosmos.

And their potential is quite high, having the capability to grow into Chaos Trees.
